status: matched post-development CLASS8 graph-guidance ablation; descriptive

variant_definitions.equal_penalty: All candidate cross-lags receive penalty weight 1.0.
variant_definitions.full_gibvar: Preferred CLASS8 cross-lags receive penalty weight 0.35 and other candidate cross-lags receive weight 1.0.
variant_definitions.forced_graph: Preferred CLASS8 cross-lags are unpenalised and required; other parents may be selected up to the common three-parent cap.

common_random_numbers.coefficient_refits: The three variants use identical moving-block bootstrap indices at each origin.
common_random_numbers.path_simulation: The three variants use identical fitted-component assignments and historical residual-block indices for every origin and seed.

aggregation: Average the 96 variable-horizon cells within each seed-origin, average the three seeds within each origin, then weight the 19 annual origins equally.
interpretation_boundary: This post-development ablation isolates graph guidance within the exploratory CLASS8 GIB-VAR. Forced inclusion imposes neither coefficient signs nor causal effects. Overall and crisis-overlap results are descriptive; the crisis subgroup is not an independent experiment.
